nodes.label: apisix start
nodes.desc: CLI entry: start/stop/restart commands (L178); start() renders nginx.conf and launches OpenResty (L1087).

nodes.label: http_init_worker
nodes.desc: Worker bootstrap: seeds RNG, starts events, lrucache, timers, balancer, admin API and the config watcher (L120, L143, L145, L151).

nodes.label: http_access_phase
nodes.desc: Per-request entry: fetches api_ctx from a pool, matches the route, merges service config, runs rewrite and access plugins (L915, L991, L1105).

nodes.label: router.lua
nodes.desc: Builds the configured HTTP router: radixtree_uri by default, radixtree_sni for SSL matching (L81, L91).

nodes.label: radixtree_uri match
nodes.desc: Matches URI, host and vars against the route table via a radixtree (L30, L51).

nodes.label: plugin framework
nodes.desc: Loads the enabled plugin list, sorts it by priority, filters per request and runs phase hooks (L420, L142, L1362).

nodes.label: upstream.set_by_route
nodes.desc: Normalizes upstream nodes, scheme and TLS settings for the matched route (L381).

nodes.label: pick_server
nodes.desc: Health-aware node picker; loads the balancer module named by upstream.type (L151, L154, L275).

nodes.label: config_etcd
nodes.desc: Watches etcd keys and syncs route, service, upstream and plugin config into workers (L722, L1256).

nodes.label: config_yaml (standalone)
nodes.desc: Standalone mode: polls apisix.yaml mtime and hot-reloads the config (L245, L421).

nodes.label: Admin API
nodes.desc: REST dispatcher on :9180: check_token, then method routed to the resource handler (L82, L176, L254).

nodes.label: admin/routes
nodes.desc: Route CRUD with schema, upstream-reference and vars-expression validation (L54, L183).
